description: Checks whether a Zenith Workspaces room is free on a given date, using Zenith's live booking calendar. Use when someone asks if a private office or the conference room is available at Zenith on a day or at a time. Inputs: space (Everest, K2, Denali, Summit, Atlas, Matterhorn, Evergreen Conference Room, or "any_office" to check all six private offices), date (YYYY-MM-DD), and optionally start (HH:MM, 24-hour, US Eastern) with duration_hours to test one slot. Returns busy times, free windows for the day, whether the requested slot is free, a price estimate, and a booking link with the date and duration filled in. Includes each room's real photos (image_url, images). Read-only: it does not hold or book the room. Rooms are bookable 24/7; availability can change until the booking is completed.

space.description: Space name or id (Everest, K2, Denali, Summit, Atlas, Matterhorn, Evergreen Conference Room) or "any_office"
